# Profile: Phundamentals (Brian Hirschfield)

## Identity

Brian Hirschfield, known as **Phundamentals**, is a former career actuary (28 years in pensions, healthcare, and annuities) who left his fiat career in June 2024 at a BTC price of $59K — quitting pensions specifically over corruption he refused to put his signature on. Now a full-time Bitcoin educator based in the Philadelphia/Lancaster area, he runs **Magic Internet Math Academy** (96+ free courses), authored **"Bitcoin for Institutions,"** founded **Philly Bitdevs**, and co-hosts five podcasts. His tagline: *"Study math, be sovereign."*

## Expertise

- **Actuarial science & risk management** — 28-year professional career; deep knowledge of bond markets, duration risk, LDI, pension underfunding ($200T+ unfunded US liabilities), insurance regulatory frameworks. Left the field calling it systemically corrupt.
- **Mathematics education** — Built a full curriculum from high school algebra through elliptic curve cryptography, integrating Rudolf Steiner, Rothbard, and Austrian economics. Teaches math as a liberal art, not STEM.
- **Bitcoin cryptography** — Self-taught from zero; proved Fermat's Little Theorem, created a 13-part ECC YouTube series (modular arithmetic → secp256k1 → Schnorr → MuSig2). Completed Base58's technical course.
- **Institutional finance** — Author of "Bitcoin for Institutions"; detailed analyses of BlackRock's ETF strategy (a liability move, not an asset move), FASB fair value accounting risks, and counterparty risk in custodial arrangements.
- **Austrian economics** — Well-read in Mises, Rothbard, Hoppe; considers Austrian economics "evergreen curriculum."
- **Lightning Network** — Original research on Lightning annuities and non-satoshi channel use cases (physical goods exchanged via hash pre-images). Deep understanding of channel mechanics, timelocks, and revocation.
- **Coffee** — Serious enthusiast (Kalita Wave, Stagg, Rancilio grinder); co-hosts Sound Coffee podcast with roaster Otis Bitmeyer.

## Key Beliefs

- **Bitcoin is the closest thing to a risk-free asset ever created.** The gap between zero counterparty risk and even a scintilla is "worth INFINITY." He is anti-diversification: *"Diversification = participation trophy invented by species who doesn't recognize predators."*
- **HODLing is exclusively an individual human action.** Institutions structurally cannot HODL; even Saylor "had to demote himself from his institution." He wrote a formal essay arguing AI and institutions cannot replicate the conviction required.
- **Against moralizing Bitcoin.** Evolved position: *"Bitcoin is no more moral than the steel that holds up a bridge. Reject people who moralize Bitcoin — they are auditioning to be the next tyrant."*
- **There is no Orange Pill.** Conviction cannot be transferred; discovery of Bitcoin is personal. *"Any conviction gained from another is false and will be eventually proven so."*
- **Vaccines and virology** — Highly controversial: denies contagious viruses have been proven since TB (1890), calls all vaccines harmful, considers HIV a "fiat disease." This is among his most stridently held positions.
- **Equality is tyranny.** Distinguishes mathematical equality (undefinable, tyrannical) from equivalence (reflexive, symmetric, transitive — verifiable). *"A world where everyone is equal is a network with only one node — the one with all the weapons."*

## Notable Contributions

- **Magic Internet Math Academy** — 96+ free interactive courses spanning Euclid's Elements through FROST threshold signatures, mass-loaded onto Nostr via bot.
- **"Bitcoin for Institutions"** — A playbook for corporate Bitcoin adoption, available for 2100 sats via Zeus Pay. Core thesis: institutions must center the individual, not the institution.

# Profile: jordan (linkinparkrulz)

## Name and Identity
Jordan is a Bitcoin privacy developer, podcaster, and community organizer best known as the creator of **Ashigaru** (a Samourai Wallet successor) and a founding voice of the **Ungovernable Misfits** podcast network. He co-hosts multiple shows — *The Bitcoin Brief*, *Freedom Tech Friday*, *Action News!!!*, and *Monero Monthly* — and operates at the intersection of privacy-tech development, podcasting 2.0 advocacy, and decentralized community building. His identity is publicly tied to the BIP47 Payment Code `paynym.rs/+linkinparkrulz`, and he signs all Ashigaru releases against that cryptographic identity.

## Expertise
- **Bitcoin Privacy / Coinjoin**: Deep practitioner and developer knowledge of Whirlpool (Tx0, Premix, Postmix, Badbank, remixing, mix-to), Tor-only networking, and UTXO management — embedded directly in Ashigaru Terminal and Desktop.
- **BIP47 / PayNyms**: Built paymentcode.io as an educational lab and verifier; advocates for decentralized PayNym directory infrastructure (BIP47DB). Integrated BIP47 message verification into Ashigaru as a release-signing mechanism.
- **Dojo / Node Packaging**: Maintains Ashigaru Terminal for Start9/StartOS (Community Marketplace), handles electrs vs. fulcrum indexer decisions, and has unofficially packaged Dojo 1.27 with Soroban additions.
- **Podcasting 2.0 / V4V**: Expert on boost mechanics, payment splits, Fountain integration, Nostr-based commenting, and chapter art. Has publicly criticized Nostr influencers for conflating Fountain boosts with Nostr zaps to inflate stats.
- **Nostr Infrastructure**: Early adopter (March 2022), runs his own relay (`wss://nostr.supremestack.xyz`), tested extensively across clients (Astral, Branle, Iris, Alphaama, Nostrudel, Yakihonne), and integrated NoComment into his personal website.
- **Self-Hosting & Web Development**: Wrote a multi-part blog series on building personal websites from scratch with NGINX, manages RSS feeds, and advocates for XMPP and SimpleX over centralized messaging.

## Key Beliefs and Positions
1. **Privacy is a human right, not a premium feature** — stated explicitly in Ashigaru Desktop release notes: "built by people who believe privacy is a human fight, not a premium feature."
2. **KYC is the illicit activity** — echoed Gigi's stance, separately noting that Swan's model proved KYC legitimizes surveillance rather than preventing crime.
3. **Lock-in is the enemy of self-custody** — drove BIP-329 label

# Profile: aljaz

## Identity
Aljaz (`aljazceru` on GitHub) is a Slovenian freedom maximalist, digital nomad, and prolific builder operating across the Nostr and Bitcoin ecosystems. A 15+ year sysadmin with a background in offensive security and exchange operations, he functions as the informal librarian, infrastructure provider, and philosophical provocateur of the Nostr community — running free public infrastructure while constantly shipping new tools, frameworks, and essays from his "battlestation" home office in the Balkans or wherever his nomadic life takes him.

## Expertise
- **Infrastructure & Systems Administration** (15+ years, professional): Runs extensive free Nostr infrastructure (relay.nostr.net serving 4M+ requests and 1.44TB traffic, njump gateways, broadcaster proxies, search, WoT relay). Deep Linux expertise across Fedora/RHEL/Ubuntu ecosystems, container orchestration, LUKS, SELinux, server hardware. Managed traffic scaling to 14M+ requests in 21 days.
- **Confidential Computing & TEEs**: Wrote comprehensive guides on attestation and confidential containers. Implemented the first Cashu mint in a TEE on Azure AMD SEV-SNP. Deep understanding of Intel SGX/TDX, AMD SEV-SNP, remote attestation, and key release mechanisms. Built confidentialinference.net comparing 9+ providers and 48+ models.
- **AI/LLMs & Agent Orchestration**: Active practitioner running local models (262K context on 16GB VRAM), testing frontier models side-by-side (DeepSeek, Qwen, Claude, GPT, Kimi K2). Built multi-agent orchestration tools (clanker-control, opencode-orchestrator), voice-to-text tools (whisper-talk), and Signal-to-LLM bridges. Reserve NVIDIA GX10/Digits for local compute.
- **Nostr Protocol & Ecosystem**: Created awesome-nostr (now nostr.net) in January 2022 — grew to 2,168+ stars, 400+ projects, 184 contributors. Built profile management tools, onboarding sites, follow cleanup tools, DVMCP SDK, and llms.txt context files for vibecoding Nostr apps. Deep fluency across NIPs, DVMs, Blossom, and protocol design.
- **Bitcoin & Lightning Network**: Running Lightning nodes since January 2019. Founded bolt.observer (Lightning monitoring SaaS, pitched at BTC Prague). Operates lnaddress.me and lightning-network.tech. Built Verso (stealth payments with BDK in Rust) and btcpayserver-breez-nodeless-spark. Deep knowledge of LND vs CLN vs LDK, channel management, UTXO management, and Cashu/ecash protocols.
- **Cybersecurity**: Professional background in offensive security and social engineering. Tracks zero-days (Windows TCP/IP RCE, OpenSSH regreSSHion, xz utils supply chain). Built IMSI catcher detection POC. Advocates GrapheneOS. Wrote on vulnerability communication in the Bitcoin ecosystem.

## Key Beliefs
- **Bitcoin is about freedom, not price**: Views Bitcoin as liberation from state oppression. Anti-HODL ("the biggest psyop"), anti-ETF, anti-strategic reserve. "KYC is the illicit activity." Black market infrastructure over "cucked companies." Parallel systems that sustain themselves rather than hyperbitcoinization. Cashflow over speculation as the true adoption strategy.
- **Absolute anti-statism**: Anarcho-capitalist/voluntaryist. All taxation is extortion; all regulation is oppression. Representative democracy cannot work because "all representatives can be captured." Seeks not reform but parallel structures: "The system hates you, build another." Views the EU ("EUSSR") and Western democracies as hypocritical tyrannies.
- **Uncompromising free speech and privacy**: Argues from first principles that laws constrain only good actors. Communities should self-regulate without state enforcement. Full anonymity in payments is non-negotiable. Refuses to throw privacy solutions "under the bus due to our purity reasons."
- **AI as cognitive amplifier for high-agency individuals**: "AI amplifies, if you're a low agency cuck the most it will do for you is give you something more to complain about." Compute sovereignty is existential — "He who controls the compute will reap the benefits of AI." Vibecoding is a real arbitrage revolution.
- **Confidential computing as "verifiable execution"**: "Bitcoin gave us verifiable money. Confidential computing gives us verifiable execution." Should be default for all freedom tech, not just well-funded institutions. "No more policy documents and pinky promises."
- **Pragmatic anti-dogmatism**: Against NostrOnly purism. Against naive self-hosting advocacy — cloud is a force multiplier. Against grant-driven development that produces abandoned projects. Prefers cashflow businesses and "lifestyle businesses" over VC-scale growth.

## Notable Contributions
- **nostr.net ecosystem directory**: Started as personal bookmarks in January 2022, became the canonical reference for the entire Nostr ecosystem (2,168+ stars, 400+ projects). Includes facelift with search functionality, llms.txt for AI-assisted development, and multiple supporting subdomains.
- **"Regulatory Capture Playbook" framework**: Detailed 21-step analysis showing how governments systematically co-opt Bitcoin from criminal-use propaganda through MiCA/travel rule to effective CBDC. Became a frequently referenced mental model in the community.
- **Confidential computing implementations**: First Cashu mint in TEE on Azure, confidentialinference.net comparison platform, and comprehensive educational guides bridging Bitcoin and AI communities around verifiable execution.

## Communication Style
Casual posts are profane, lowercase, and meme-heavy; technical posts are meticulously structured with headers, code blocks, and detailed explanations. Argues from first principles rather than appeals to authority. Sarcasm as a primary weapon ("govern me harder daddy"). Self-deprecating about procrastination and hardware struggles. Prolific across ~2,000 posts spanning 30+ months.

## Recurring Themes
- Freedom tech and anti-authoritarian infrastructure building
- AI/LLM tooling, vibecoding, and compute sovereignty
- Nostr protocol design and free public infrastructure
- Confidential computing as verifiable execution
- Bitcoin economics (custody, Lightning, ecash) and the ecosystem's drift toward compliance
- Decentralized compute monetization via DVMs and residential infrastructure

## Relationships
- **Sovereign Engineering community**: SEC-01 alumni and advocate; considers it "by far the best thing I did last year." Close ties to ContextVM ("crew is on fire"), Stuart Bowman, PABLOF7
